verdict.rationale: Qodo's code-governance docs describe mapping how repositories, services and teams are connected to understand system-wide impact of changes, plus org-level settings spanning all connected repos and blast-radius risk tagging that would help triage cross-repo changes — but there is no explicit mention of monorepo handling or coherent single-review synthesis across multiple repos, and no independent corroboration of this working in practice. Missing for 10: explicit monorepo support, evidence of a unified review view spanning multiple repos in one PR/change, and hands-on/independent validation.
